scope: Nordic fuel-gauge process current-selection contract in the G2 source-only candidate

recovered_branch.fact: The raw IEEE-754 current sign bit selects the charging branch; nonnegative current selects it only while the VBUS byte is set.
In the charging branch, a non-NaN stored charge limit is used directly only when charge state equals 2 (CC); otherwise current is multiplied by the charge correction factor.
The discharging branch multiplies current by the discharge correction factor.

source.change: Replaced the old sign-only factor choice with the observed sign/VBUS/CC-limit branches in corrected_current; the existing gauge state and source-only model remain.

limits: The stock process also invokes large proprietary model functions at 0x43A698 and 0x43A1B0; this C model remains deliberately uncalibrated and is not byte-identical.
The source model retains finite-input and time-interval guards not seen in the 300-byte stock wrapper; complete input equivalence is not claimed.
This host branch check and source link do not establish physical battery behavior, whole-firmware source completeness, or OTA byte identity.
